metadata.verification: All 40 page images visually reviewed. 132 N/beta/SE/p/Holm outcome rows, 110 deletion coverage rows, 110 slope rows (108 estimable), and 22 Wald p/Holm rows structured. CI is derived from rounded beta/SE, not literal PDF transcription. Variation and contribution tables retained as page images/OCR, not certified as full numeric tables.
